avoid_supplements.name: Cholinergic herbs (Physostigmine, Pilocarpine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of atropine's anticholinergic effects; may precipitate cholinergic crisis or reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on incompatibility

avoid_supplements.name: Scopolamine-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects leading to severe xerostomia, urinary retention, constipation, and central toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; advise patient to discontinue before atropine therapy

caution_supplements.name: Antihistamines (diphenhydramine, chlorpheniramine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects including dry mouth, urinary retention, and constipation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for anticholinergic symptoms; use lowest effective doses

caution_supplements.name: Ginger supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild prokinetic effects; potential modest opposition to atropine's GI-slowing effects
caution_supplements.action: Educate patient; generally safe at conventional doses

avoid_foods.name: High-fiber foods in excess (when atropine-induced constipation is present)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Atropine reduces GI motility; excess fiber may exacerbate constipation and bowel obstruction risk
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on balanced fiber intake; ensure adequate hydration and monitor bowel function

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, chocolate)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine stimulates GI motility and may partially offset atropine-induced constipation; minor anticholinergic antagonism
caution_foods.action: Inform patient; moderate intake generally acceptable

caution_foods.name: Spicy foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase gastric irritation or interact minimally with atropine's GI effects
caution_foods.action: Tolerate in moderation; monitor for GI distress

monitoring_notes: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity (mydriasis, tachycardia, urinary retention, constipation, confusion). Educate patient on avoiding additional anticholinergic agents and maintaining adequate hydration and fluid intake to mitigate constipation risk.
